description: Implement the Android Kotlin app that connects to relay, receives dial/sms commands, auto-dials, manages dual-SIM, and maintains foreground service for background keep-alive.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/yunkiro/android/ directory with standard Android project structure using Gradle. Create settings.gradle.kts, build.gradle.kts (project-level), and app/build.gradle.kts (module-level)

Configure app/build.gradle.kts: minSdk=26 (Android 8), targetSdk=34, applicationId=com.yunkiro.dialer, enable viewBinding, add dependencies: OkHttp (WebSocket), Kotlin coroutines, AndroidX (core-ktx, appcompat, lifecycle, work-manager)

Create AndroidManifest.xml with permissions: INTERNET, CALL_PHONE, READ_PHONE_STATE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE. Declare activities, services, broadcast receivers

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/relay/RelayConnection.kt: OkHttp WebSocket client. Connects to relay URL, sends auth_request with PIN + role=phone + device_id + device_name. Handles auth_response. Reconnect with exponential backoff. 30s ping interval.

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/relay/MessageHandler.kt: Parses incoming JSON messages. Dispatches: dial -> DialService, hangup -> HangupService, sms -> SmsService. Sends ack for each received message. Deduplication by messageId (LRU cache of last 100 IDs).

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/relay/Protocol.kt: Data classes for all protocol messages matching relay protocol (AuthRequest, AuthResponse, DialCommand, HangupCommand, SmsCommand, Ack, DialResult, SmsResult, DeviceStatus, Ping, Pong)

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/service/DialService.kt: Receives dial command with phone_number and sim_slot. Uses Intent.ACTION_CALL to initiate call. Handles dual-SIM selection via PhoneAccountHandle. Reports dial_result back through RelayConnection.

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/service/KeepAliveService.kt: Foreground service with persistent notification showing connection status. Holds partial wake lock during reconnection. Registers for network change broadcasts. Implements Doze-mode survival strategy (alarm manager as backup).
Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/receiver/BootReceiver.kt: BroadcastReceiver for BOOT_COMPLETED. Starts KeepAliveService on device boot.
Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/receiver/NetworkChangeReceiver.kt: Monitors connectivity changes. When network switches (WiFi<->Cellular), triggers relay reconnection.

Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/ui/MainActivity.kt: Main activity with PIN input screen (first launch), connection status display, device info, manual connect/disconnect button, SIM card selection preference.
Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/ui/SettingsActivity.kt: Settings screen: relay URL, PIN code, preferred SIM slot (Card1/Card2/Ask/Remember), autostart toggle, notification preferences.
Create app/src/main/res/layout/ XML layouts: activity_main.xml (PIN input, status card, connect button), activity_settings.xml (preferences list)
Create app/src/main/java/com/yunkiro/dialer/util/DeviceInfo.kt: Generates stable device_id (UUID stored in SharedPreferences), gets device_name (Build.MODEL), gets SIM info.
Verify: ./gradlew assembleDebug compiles the APK, ./gradlew test passes unit tests
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew assembleDebug compiles without errors producing an APK
Protocol data classes correctly serialize/deserialize JSON matching relay format
RelayConnection handles WebSocket lifecycle (connect, auth, reconnect, close)
DialService can construct ACTION_CALL intent with phone number
KeepAliveService runs as foreground service with notification
BootReceiver registered to start service on device boot
Message deduplication works (same messageId ignored on retry)
Dual-SIM selection logic present in DialService
findings: Android SDK installed at /opt/android-sdk. Java 17 required (Java 25 too new for AGP 8.2.2 / Gradle 8.5). Used unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues=true to handle android.util.Log in unit tests. AGP 8.2.2 with Kotlin 1.9.22 and OkHttp 4.12.0. Used @drawable/ic_notification as app icon instead of mipmap to avoid creating png launcher icons. assembleDebug produces APK at app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk. All 33 unit tests pass (ProtocolTest + MessageHandlerTest). local.properties with sdk.dir is gitignored.
